analogy.rationale: PRKCA (PKC-alpha) is a serine/threonine kinase whose activation by phorbol esters or DAG mimetics triggers a downstream phosphorylation program; however, PKC is broadly expressed and its transcriptional footprint at 6-24 h is modest, so the closest reference classes are PKC inhibitors (opposite sign but same pathway) and general protein kinase inhibitors, with weak overall response expected.
